pinyin: Chí ér yíng zhī， bù rú qí yǐ；
Chuāi ér zhuō zhī， bù kě zhǎng bǎo。
Jīn yù mǎn táng， mò zhī néng shǒu；
Fù guì ér jiāo， zì yí qí jiù。
Gōng suì shēn tuì， tiān zhī dào。
english: It is easier to carry an empty cup than one that is filled to the brim.
The sharper the knife the easier it is to dull. The more wealth you possess the harder it is to protect. Pride brings its own trouble.
When you have accomplished your goal simply walk away. This is the path way to Heaven.
